name.description: What this is, e.g. 'Under-sink garbage disposal'.

nodes.description: Every piece of geometry. Parents come before children. Metres; origin at the floor centre; +y up; +z toward the viewer.

parent.description: Parent node id, or empty for the root. Position and rotation are in the parent's frame.

size.description: Shape dimensions in metres; meaning depends on the shape.

position.description: [x, y, z] in the parent's frame.

color.description: Hex like #c8ccd2 to tint the material, or empty for its usual colour.

points.description: lathe: [radius, y] profile; hose: [x, y, z] path; panel: holes as [x, y, radius] or [x, y, width, height]. Empty otherwise.

text.description: Printed text for a label, empty otherwise.

repeat.description: [count, dx, dy, dz, spin_degrees] copies, each shifted and spun about the parent's y axis; empty for one.

parts.description: Nodes the guide can point at or move. The node and everything under it moves together.

node.description: Id of the node that is this part; use the blueprint part id.

axis.description: slide/press: direction; hinge/twist/turn: rotation axis; debris: direction it is carried away. In the parent's frame.

amount.description: slide: metres; press: depth in metres; hinge/twist/turn: degrees, sign picks the way; debris: metres away.

lift.description: twist: metres it lifts out along the axis after turning; 0 otherwise.

pivot.description: hinge: point on the hinge line in the node's own frame; [0, 0, 0] otherwise.

view.description: Direction from the part to the camera, e.g. [0.4, 0.6, 1].

rest.description: Joint amount it starts at: 0 normally, 1 for a valve that is normally open.
